blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — An environmental advocate has called on local governments and residents to oppose a proposed 10,265.3-hectare mineral reservation in Puerto Galera and San Teodoro, warning of potential threats to watersheds, forests, biodiversity and community livelihoods. The appeal came as the Department of Environment and Natural Resources-Mines and Geosciences Bureau (DENR-MGB) in Mimaropa prepares to hold the final public hearing on the proposed declaration on Tuesday, Nov. 24.
